private_lines.Paola: You work as a bank clerk at a branch in central Turin, usually from half past eight to four, and you drive your daughter to her training sessions three evenings a week. You live with your partner and your daughter in an apartment, and your days are busy but steady.

private_lines.Martina: You work as an accountant in an office in Turin, with busy periods at tax time and otherwise steady hours until about six. You live with your mother in a house on the city's edge, so you do the cooking and the errands, and your days revolve around work and your daughter's swimming.
private_lines.Roberto: You run a small car repair workshop in Turin, so you are up early and on your feet most of the day, and you usually finish around five in the afternoon.
